text.p: Tropical Cyclone 08B is in the Bay of Bengal near 13n/84e, moving north northwest at 8 mph. Top winds are near 50 mph, and are expected to increase to near 60-65 mph during the next 24-36 hours as the storm turns to the northwest, making landfall over east central India toward the end of this forecast period. This system threatens to bring flooding rain to areas that were hit by Tropical Cyclone 07B a few weeks ago. Winds should not be as damaging.

Tropical Cyclone Chantelle, with 40 mph winds, is over the South Indian Ocean near 5s/74e, moving slowly northwest. It will turn to the west-northwest, weaken, and dissipate over open waters within 24-36 hours. This system is a moderate risk to shipping.
